en: The Pair on Accompanied by Pleasure, and the Triplet on the Wholesome.
Dependent on a wholesome state accompanied by pleasure, a state that is neither accompanied by pleasure nor wholesome arises by way of root condition.

Dependent on a wholesome state not accompanied by pleasure, a state that is neither accompanied by pleasure nor wholesome arises by way of root condition. Dependent on both a wholesome state accompanied by pleasure and a wholesome state not accompanied by pleasure...

Dependent on a state accompanied by pleasure that is neither wholesome nor unwholesome, a state that is neither accompanied by pleasure nor wholesome arises by way of root-condition (*hetu-paccaya*). Under root-conditions there are three; ... pe ... under non-disappearance there are three.

Dependent on an unwholesome state accompanied by pleasure, a state that is neither accompanied by pleasure nor unwholesome arises by way of root-condition. Dependent on an unwholesome state not accompanied by pleasure, a state that is neither accompanied by pleasure nor unwholesome...

A state arises by way of root-condition (*hetupaccaya*). Dependent on unwholesome states accompanied by pleasure and unwholesome states not accompanied by pleasure, a state that is neither accompanied by pleasure nor unwholesome arises by way of root-condition. [In the case of] root, there are three;
... pe ... in the case of non-disappearance, there are three. (The indeterminate root has exactly three conditions.)
